questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] Under what type of tree did Siddhartha Gautama, later known as the Buddha, attain enlightenment?
A. Sandalwood tree
B. Bodhi tree
C. Neem tree
Answer: B. Bodhi tree is a large and sacred fig tree (Ficus religiosa). The original Bodhi tree is located in Bodh Gaya, India, and is considered one of the most important pilgrimage sites for Buddhists. The locals believe that the tree standing there today is a direct descendant of the original tree under which Buddha attained enlightenment.
questions.de: Unter welcher Art von Baum erlangte Siddhartha Gautama, der spätere Buddha, die Erleuchtung?
questions.en: Under what type of tree did Siddhartha Gautama, later known as the Buddha, attain enlightenment?

timeline.labelEn: Siddhartha Gautama attains enlightenment under the Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya
timeline.labelDe: Siddhartha Gautama erlangt unter dem Bodhi-Baum in Bodh Gaya die Erleuchtung

questions.notes: Ficus religiosa, at Bodh Gaya (Bihar, India), around the 5th century BCE. Accept 'Bodhi tree' / 'Bo tree'.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the largest planet in our solar system?
A. Mars B. Jupiter C. Saturn
Answer: B.
questions.de: Welcher ist der größte Planet unseres Sonnensystems?
questions.en: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?

timeline.labelEn: Galileo first observes Jupiter through a telescope and sees its large moons
timeline.labelDe: Galileo beobachtet Jupiter erstmals mit dem Teleskop und sieht seine großen Monde
